root_cause.text: The `batadv_v_elp_get_throughput()` function called `batadv_get_real_netdev()` which internally acquires the RTNL lock, creating a potential double-lock deadlock when the function was already invoked with the RTNL lock held and subsequently cancelled via `cancel_delayed_work_sync()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch replaces the call to `batadv_get_real_netdev()` (which uses `rtnl_lock()` internally) with `rtnl_trylock()` followed by a call to the lockless variant `__batadv_get_real_netdev()`. The commit message explicitly states: "for cfg80211 interfaces, batadv_get_real_netdev() was called - which also uses rtnl_lock(). The approach for __ethtool_get_link_ksettings() must also be used instead and the lockless version __batadv_get_real_netdev() has to be called." The patch also adds a comment explaining that "the elp worker will be cancelled while the rtnl_lock is held" and that `cancel_delayed_work_sync()` would "wait forever when the elp work_item was started and it is then also trying to rtnl_lock."
